title: on at by with about (prepositions)
summary: Частые предлоги в устойчивых выражениях: **on holiday, at the weekend, by car, with a pen, about a film, for / of**.
ru:
## Одни и те же предлоги, разные значения
Многие выражения с предлогами надо просто выучить. Посмотрим самые частые.

## on
- **on holiday / on a trip / on a tour** — в отпуске, в поездке
- **on TV / on the radio / on the phone / on the internet** — по ТВ, по радио, по телефону, в интернете
- **on foot** — пешком
- **on Monday / on 5 May** — в понедельник, 5 мая
> We're **on holiday** in Spain. — Мы в отпуске в Испании.
> I saw it **on TV**. — Я видела это по телевизору.

## at
- **at the weekend** (брит.), **at night, at Christmas, at 5 o'clock**
- **at the age of 20**
> I don't work **at the weekend**. — Я не работаю в выходные.

## by
- способ передвижения: **by car, by bus, by train, by plane, by bike, by taxi, by boat**
- **by post / by email** — почтой, по электронной почте
- **by Dickens / by Picasso** — автор: «написано Диккенсом»
> We travel **by train**. — Мы ездим поездом.
> Who is this book **by**? — Кто автор этой книги?
Но: **on foot** (не ~~by foot~~).

## with
- **with** + чем / с кем: *I write **with** a pen. She's **with** her friends.*
- **a man with a beard** — мужчина с бородой

## about
- **about** = о, про: *a book **about** animals; a film **about** love; talk **about** your day*.

## for и of
- **for** — для: *a present **for** you*; **for** — в течение: *for two days*.
- **of** — принадлежность / часть: *a photo **of** my family*.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~We came by foot.~~ → We came **on foot**.
- ~~I go to school with the bus.~~ → I go to school **by** bus.
- ~~We're in holiday.~~ → We're **on** holiday.
- ~~I saw it in TV.~~ → I saw it **on** TV.
en:
## Same prepositions, different uses
Many expressions with prepositions must be learnt as a whole.

## on
- **on holiday / on a trip / on a tour**
- **on TV / on the radio / on the phone / on the internet**
- **on foot**
- **on Monday / on 5 May**
> We're **on holiday** in Spain.
> I saw it **on TV**.

## at
- **at the weekend, at night, at Christmas, at 5 o'clock**
- **at the age of 20**

## by
- transport: **by car, by bus, by train, by plane, by bike, by taxi**
- **by post / by email**
- the author: **a book by Dickens**
> We travel **by train**. Who is this book **by**?
But: **on foot** (not ~~by foot~~).

## with
- **with** a tool or a person: *I write **with** a pen. She's **with** her friends.*
- **a man with a beard**

## about
- **about** = on the subject of: *a book **about** animals; a film **about** love*.

## for and of
- **for**: *a present **for** you; for two days*.
- **of**: *a photo **of** my family*.

## Common mistakes
- ~~We came by foot.~~ → We came **on foot**.
- ~~We're in holiday.~~ → We're **on** holiday.
- ~~I go to school with the bus.~~ → I go to school **by** bus.
structure:
## Таблица выражений
| Предлог | Выражения |
|---|---|
| **on** | on holiday, on a trip, on TV, on the radio, on the phone, on foot, on Monday |
| **at** | at the weekend, at night, at Christmas, at five o'clock |
| **by** | by car / bus / train / plane / bike, by post, by email, a book by ... |
| **with** | with a pen, with a friend, a man with a beard |
| **about** | a film about ..., talk about ..., think about ... |
| **for** | a present for ..., for two weeks |
| **of** | a photo of ..., a cup of tea |

## Формулы
> travel / go **by** + транспорт (без артикля): *by bus*
> **on** + the + средство: *on the bus* (в конкретном автобусе)

## Запомните
- **by bus** (способ) — **on the bus** (в автобусе, место).
- **on foot** — единственное исключение: не by.

items.text: She cut the bread {{with}} a sharp knife.
This is a film {{about}} a famous singer.
Do you often talk to your friends {{on}} the phone?
Who is this painting {{by}}? — It's by Picasso.
It's a nice day. Let's go {{on}} foot.

exercises.title: Предлог или нет?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **on, at, by, with, for, of, about**.

items.text: I bought this present {{for}} my mother.
Look at that man {{with}} a big dog.
I've got a photo {{of}} my family.
She's been {{on}} a trip to Italy.
I'm reading an interesting book {{about}} space.
